Tractoverse — recorded decisions & running task list

Source: DECISIONS.md

This file holds task-specific decisions and the running to-do list for tractoverse. It is git-versioned but excluded from the R build via .Rbuildignore. Durable, cross-task project facts live in AGENTS.md (which is prepended to every prompt and should stay lean).

Running task list

Meta-package build-out (in progress). Status: [ ] = open, [x] = done, [~] = in progress.

Decisions log

pkgdown dark theme (pkgdown 2.2.1 architecture)

The dark brand for the pkgdown site is wired via template.bootstrap: 5 + template.bootswatch: darkly + template.theme: arrow-dark + pkgdown/extra.scss in _pkgdown.yml.

There is no separate pkgdown.css file in pkgdown 2.2.1 for Bootstrap 5. Custom Sass is compiled by bslib directly into docs/deps/bootstrap-5.3.8/bootstrap.min.css (via build_bslib()). A “missing pkgdown.css” therefore does NOT mean the theme failed — the compiled bootstrap.min.css should contain --bslib-preset-name: darkly, the extra.scss brand tokens (e.g. #0d1117 bg, #58a6ff accent, #161b22 surface), and the pre code span.* arrow-dark highlighting rules. Verify by grepping those markers in the compiled file.

pkgdown/ being in .Rbuildignore is irrelevant: bs_theme_rules() reads pkg/extra.scss via pkg$src_path from the source directory, not the temp-installed library. template.theme (default arrow-light) controls the syntax-highlight palette independent of the lightswitch toggle; set arrow-dark for a dark shell.

build_site() reports an accessibility check for README images missing alt-text — give the color swatches descriptive alt text (e.g. “fiber signature color #59aaea”).

Filenames

  • Dashes, not underscores for file/script/resource names (esp. in data-raw/); R function/object/variable names and .R files outside data-raw/ stay snake_case. (Recorded here and in AGENTS.md for future tasks.)

Logo family (approved art direction, light-bg redesign)

Task-specific logo build decisions — kept here, out of AGENTS.md, because they are specific to the logo-generation task and its regeneration runs.

The 6 package logos are rebuilt on a common shell:

  • Elements (only 3): the package name (much larger), a glyph (a transparent symmetric pyramidal tract that fans left/right and fills the hexagon), and a FontAwesome icon emblem.
  • Background: white / light. Border: black hexagon #111111, pointy-top, R = 300, canvas W = 520 (round(sqrt(3)R)), H = 600 (round(2R)).
  • Cone glyph (APPROVED v24): the exact-symmetric butterfly built from a single hemisphere via mirror_x_side="L" in build-scene.R: bL = cl[iL] (30 crown-sampled CST_L streamlines) as the left wing, right wing = mirror_x(bL) reflected across X = 0. This replaces the old merge of the two unequal anatomy halves (which was right-hemisphere-heavier). Rendered at splay 0 (raw, uncanted anatomy), tinted with the package color.
  • Per-package color everywhere: tract, name, and icon all use the package palette color.

Emblem = FontAwesome icons (hand-drawn polygon emblem REJECTED)

Do NOT hand-draw/draw the emblem with polygons (the earlier class-emblem polygon was rejected as “super ugly; bundles are super fuzzy”). Use FontAwesome icons instead, per package (fontawesome v0.5.3; rsvg renders SVG → 600×600 RGBA PNG with the shape in the alpha channel, which is chroma-keyed into an alpha mask and tinted with the package color):

Package FontAwesome icon
riot feather-pointed
rtists palette
bot magnifying-glass-chart
fiber bezier-curve
toad book-atlas
master blender

Shared layout requirements

  • Horizontal centering of the tract is the common layout issue across all 6. It is a render/scene rotational asymmetry (the two anatomy halves differ: left bundle 5577 streamlines, right 2397; right half comes out consistently denser ⇒ right-hemisphere-heavier in every render, e.g. LR occupancy ratio ~0.94–0.99). Bbox-centering alone leaves the glyph subtly off the hex’s vertical axis. Guarantee the tract’s content centre-of-mass lands on the hex center (col W/2 = 260) rather than centering only the bounding box.
  • Vertical placement fills the pointy-top hexagon symmetrically (apexes near top/bottom), as in logo-fiber-v15.png / logo-fiber-v18-test.png.

Render parameters (agreed) — RE-BUILD renders with these

  • 30 streamlines per side (nL = 30, nR = 30), not the old 120/side.
  • Downsampling is done in the densest areas on the top area (the crown / uppermost part of each bundle), so the sparse fan stays even near the apex. This replaces the old uniform sample.int(5577, 120) / sample.int(2397, 120).
  • Re-implemented and PERSISTED in data-raw/crown-sample.R (canonical; supersedes the old scratch /tmp/pa-501/logos3/crown-sample.R): crown_sample(bundle, n=30, z_frac=0.25) selects the crown (points at Z >= zmin + 0.25*(zmax-zmin), the uppermost slab), orders streamlines by their crown fan position (mean X of their crown points), then takes DETERMINISTIC even spacing (~ns/n rank step) for full-width, even-near-apex coverage. make_crown_strat(path, n) writes the list(iL=, iR=) index rds. This replaced the earlier interactive algorithm (lost; only its crown_strat_*.rds outputs survived). The re-implementation matches the original’s measured span (left crown-X ~[-48.8,-11.1], peak-Z ~[50.4,77.1]). The old crown_strat_*.rds indices were NOT reproducible (interactive density thinning) - visual parity is the goal, validated by pixels + review.

Build pipeline (canonical: data-raw/, driver = logo-family.R)

The minimal data-raw/ set regenerates the full 6-package light-bg family from scratch. Single entry point: Rscript data-raw/logo-family.R (from repo root; --pkg fiber smoke-tests one). Runs the v24-approved exact-symmetric butterfly:

  1. crown-sample.R — crown_sample(), make_crown_strat().
  2. build-scene.R — PALETTE, make_scene() (v24 mirror_x_side="L" single-hemisphere exact-symmetric butterfly: bL = cl[iL], bR = mirror_x(bL) across X=0; cam_view=c(0,1,0), cam_up=c(0,0,1), cam_dist=1.9), mirror_x(), patch_camera(), patch_axes(), mirror_depth(), splay_bundle().
  3. compose-core.R (low-level raster helpers) + compose-logo.R (compose_logo(), fa_tile()), which chroma-keys the white tract from the black-bg screenshot and centers the content centre-of-mass on col 260.
  4. screenshot.R — chromote (the webshot2 browser lib) + a Chrome-for-Testing build screenshots the served widget (--use-gl=swiftshader, 1200x1200 viewport, DPR=2), replacing the old Playwright screenshot.py.
  5. Widget is served in-process by httpuv::runStaticServer (no Python subprocess; srv$getPort() → screenshot.R; on.exit(httpuv::stopServer)). Replaced the old python3 http.server + shell port-finder, whose embedded single quotes broke through sh -c.

cl/cr sourcing: logo-family.R loads CST_L/CST_R from the gitignored data-raw/.render/ cache (seeded: HCP1065_CST_L.rds 3.08MB / CST_R.rds 1.26MB). On a cold cache it pulls toad::HCP1065_CST_L/R() (GitHub-releases download, no caching in toad) and caches ~4.3MB. Verified identical to cl (5577) / cr (2397). make_crown_strat regenerates .render/crown_strat_30.rds.

Outputs → inst/brand/logos/{pkg}.png + tractoverse.png (1290x1680 white, 2x3 grid on a 600x520 canvas at 1-based origins: fiber(30,30), master(30,580), rtists(30,1130), riot(660,30), toad(660,580), bot(660,1130)).

Determinism / v24 note: screenshot, compose, and crown-strat are all deterministic (two screenshots of one scene are byte-identical; crown indices reproduce exactly from the cached bundles). Regenerated logos are structurally identical to the approved v24 (tract axis col 260, same bbox, glyph fills the hexagon) but NOT byte-identical: the current crown_sample is a re-implementation aimed at visual parity, and v24’s original streamline indices were interactive/non-reproducible and deleted. Confirm with the user whether visual parity is acceptable before overwriting inst/brand/logos/ (back up first).
